_declared_values.leadSeconds: 0 -- VC-0001 is voiced from frame 0; 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json puts the HOOK at 0.0s.

_declared_values.captionLeadSeconds: 0.0 -- 08_edit/captions.final.v001.srt will carry the house 0.60 s lead when it is written; this config adds none on top.
_declared_values.hookSeconds: MEASURED 2026-08-27 from 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json: section HOOK spans 0.0 to 8.773 across three chunks (VC-0001..VC-0003). ACT_1 opens at 10.573, ACT_2 at 233.883, ACT_3 at 546.851, ACT_4 at 1026.368, ENDING at 1678.845, and the last chunk ends at 1772.827. Not estimated. The hook is short because this episode's hook is three sentences; the number is what the voice actually did, not the 8-second house target it happens to sit beside.
_declared_values.not_yet_on_disk: `assets` and `captions` name the files the staging and caption steps will write (asset_manifest.v003.json, captions.final.v001.srt). Neither exists yet, which is the same state EP78, EP79, EP81 and EP82 were in when their filmconfigs were authored -- the config declares the contract, the later step fills it. 06_audio/narration_index.v001.json and remotion/public/max737/narration.mp3 DO exist and were read for this file.
_declared_values.figures_by_section: Authored 2026-08-27 from 03_script/script.en.v001.md and EP83_max737_FACTS_LEDGER.v001.md. Counts are 17/17/17/17 across ACT_1..ACT_4, at the top of episode_spec's figure_beats_per_act [13,17]; HOOK 2 and ENDING 2; 72 cards in total, the same shape as EP82. EVERY number on a card is a number the narration speaks -- 21, 96, 2, 10, 6.1, 3.8, 20, 93, 103, 189, 11, 4, 1000000, 200, 2, 0.6, 2.5, 9, 28, 79, 15, 2.68, 150, 387, 157, 243.6, 1770 and 500 all appear in the script -- and every `stat` `value` is numeric so nothing can render as NaN. No `stat` carries a `group` key (the FigureSpec union does not give `stat` one; only `numberticker` has it).
_declared_values.ranges_are_never_stats: Every range in this record is drawn as a kinetic pair or a comparison, never squeezed into one number card: the 200-to-400 million dollar training bill (MX-613), the Mach 0.6-0.8 to Mach 0.2-0.8 expansion (MX-106), the 0.6 to 2.5 degree authority change (MX-615, drawn as compbars), the 28-of-87 to 79-of-91 delegation shift (MX-619), and the 96-minutes-against-11-minutes comparison that is ACT_1's whole argument.
_declared_values.no_OP_section: episode_spec's section_vocabulary lists OP, but narration_index has no OP chunks -- the brand opening is an overlay on the HOOK, not a spoken section. A card there would have no window to live in.
_declared_values.money_scale: The three parts of the 2021 payment are one compbars row (243.6 / 1770 / 500, in $M) rather than three stat cards, because the point the narration makes is the SHAPE -- the airline customers received more than three times what the families received -- and that is a comparison, not three numbers. The $1 million per-aircraft discount is a separate stat card in ACT_2 because it belongs to the training decision, not to the settlement.
_declared_values.quarantine: Nothing on screen says Boeing was convicted, found guilty or lost a criminal case: the ACT_4 closing card says the case was dismissed and nobody was convicted of anything (MX-308). Nothing on screen names or depicts the acquitted individual; the ACT_3 card states the acquittal on all four counts (MX-405) and no card implies he lied. No card says the jump-seat pilot saved the previous flight -- the ACT_1 cards attribute the cut-out to the captain (MX-707). The FIFTEEN card carries its frame on the card itself ('on the agency's own analysis') and is immediately followed by the 2.68-per-million card and the FIFTEEN CRASHES / BELOW THE THRESHOLD pair, so the number never appears without the guideline beside it (MX-602, MX-609, MX-610). No card adopts either ending of the ET302 dispute: the card says two authorities wrote two different endings (MX-801, MX-805, MX-806). No card says MCAS was hidden from pilots as a deliberate decision to conceal it from pilots -- the cards say the name came out of the manual with the regulator's approval (MX-616) and that the pilots were never told the system existed (MX-111). The number 346 appears on no card at all, per episode_spec's forbidden_claims. No card carries an airline name, an airline livery, a company mark or a readable document.
_declared_values.act_4_selection: ACT_4 runs 651 seconds and carries the second accident, the grounding, the contested reports, the money and the end of the criminal case; 17 cards is the spec ceiling, so the five committee themes (MX-617), the Fifth Circuit order (MX-309/MX-311) and the return to service (MX-621) are carried by the narration and by the description rather than by a card. The 346 and the rescue diver (MX-622) are narrated once, plainly, and are deliberately not drawn.
